assumptions.message: CHK_01: The Precord leaves the approving decision open. The builder assumes the first declared decision, 'Confirm and proceed', approves. It moves the case on; the other decisions do not.

CHK_02: The Precord leaves the approving decision open. The builder assumes the first declared decision, 'Approve agent', approves. It releases a write and moves the case on; the other decisions do not.
These open items have no answer. The build uses each item's default_assumption and writes it down where it is used.
The confirmed stack has no observability at Pilot. The platform default applies.
Client IT did not choose. The answers to Q1, Q8, Q9 have answer_source Default: they are platform defaults, not client answers. The user selects the deployment target. The build is L0 only.

Step S6 is person-owned or not automated, and the Precord also gives it to an agent (BLK_02 action ACT_06; BLK_02 serves_steps; CHK_02 resume_action_id ACT_06; integration_map INT_UI6; orchestration ownership BLK_02; rule BR-ACT_06 (no agent enforces it)). The builder keeps the person as owner and does not automate the step. The builder removes the actions and integrations of that step from the agent checks, bindings and context. Module 1 must settle the conflict.
The package ships no standard/schemas/, so the builder did not validate the files against schemas (RD-5). It trusts the close gate in manifest.gate instead (D-11).
